name: Monalisa Dash Dwibedy

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Monalisa Dash Dwibedy writes poetry in Odia and English, alongside travel essays for OdishaPlus. Her books include the English collection ‘Pearls of Strawberry Moon’. A background in IT consulting sits beside a literary interest in landscape and inward reflection; in her travel writing, places are encountered through affection, remembered sensations and the lives around them.

Her Odia poem ‘ଈଶ୍ବର’ (‘God’) in Kabita Live turns a spiritual figure into a witness to the pressures of the present. Heat, cyclones, urbanisation and the appetite for power make the search for a compassionate heart increasingly difficult. The poem’s repeated return to God gives its social questions a searching rhythm, ending with an absence within human hearts rather than a distant heaven.
